name: Smoulder
description: A shape half burnt away: the noise stretched along one axis so the damage runs with the grain.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: 1 + 0.2 * cos(5t); scale: 0.9); clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: 1 + 0.2 * cos(5t); scale: 0.9); filter: @svg-filter(feTurbulence { type: fractalNoise; baseFrequency: 0.4 0.02; numOctaves: 2; seed: 23 } feDisplacementMap { in: SourceGraphic; scale: 12 }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
